title: Best Paid Social Media Experts (2026): Hire for Meta Ads
description: How to hire a paid social media expert for Facebook, Instagram or TikTok ads: package contents, the brief, price factors and red flags.
intro: Paid social ads put your product in front of people who were not searching for it, so the creative and the targeting do most of the work. Campaigns fail most often because tracking is missing, the ads are tired, or the account belongs to someone else. This guide helps you agree on those points first.

faq.q: Which platform should I advertise on?
faq.a: Wherever your customers spend time. Facebook and Instagram reach a broad audience, TikTok skews younger, and LinkedIn suits business buyers. A good specialist will recommend one platform to start with rather than all of them at once.

faq.q: Does the specialist create the ads too?
faq.a: Not always. Some only set up and manage campaigns and expect you to supply images and videos. Check whether ad creative is included, and how many versions you will get.

faq.q: What is a pixel and why does it matter?
faq.a: A pixel is a small piece of tracking code on your website that tells the ad platform when a visitor buys or signs up. Without it, the platform cannot learn who to show your ads to. Setting it up should be part of the job.

faq.q: Is the ad budget part of the fee?
faq.a: No. You pay the platform directly for ads, from your own ad account. The specialist's fee is separate. Agree on a spending limit before anything goes live.

faq.q: How often should ads be changed?
faq.a: People who see the same ad many times stop reacting to it. Ask how the specialist tests new images, videos and text, and how often they plan to refresh them.
